statement.task: Lexicon visualization at any component scope: a prettyprint/ASCII token-space dump (agent-facing) AND a serializable export (JSON/YAML). The lexicon() projection already exists on every Component; this is the rendering/serialization layer over it. Same dual-consumer intent as the AST visualizer: plain text dump for agents, dressed-up visual form for artifacts and human review. Pairs with followup_eec8c2eb (AST visualizer).
